name: Ogre Spider

items.name: Web Sense
items.text: The ogre spider has imprecise Tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

items.name: Eerie Flexibility
items.text: An ogre spider can fit through tight spaces as if it were a Large creature. While Squeezing, it can move at its full Speed.

items.name: Ogre Spider Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude save

---
Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison damage, Clumsy 1, and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 poison damage, clumsy 1, and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 4 2d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

items.name: Web Trap
items.text: A creature hit by the ogre spider's web attack is Immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface until it Escapes (DC 22).

text:
These terrifying creatures grow as large as elephants. The placement of their eyes above their wide mandibles evokes the grimacing visage of an ogre's leer. Ogres find ogre spider faces simultaneously amusing and adorable, but in most cases, ogres' attempts to keep these spiders as pets result in dead ogres and well-fed spiders.

---
Spiders range dramatically in size, yet many are to some extent venomous.
